scientific_integrity: Proof is symbolic for arbitrary fields and finite/infinite domains. Finite table checks are illustrations rather than exhaustive proofs of the general assertions.
scientific_limitations: Middle and right nuclei are classified only for Latin quandles; only finite-support algebras are considered. Prior left nucleus of odd dihedral algebras and finite-Latin sum identity are credited; possibility of equivalent older formulation remains. No independent audit.
title: Associator span and nuclei of connected and Latin quandle algebras
